descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S12 「现成的 spec：别处改了它的数据或病人名单时，卡片实时更新」 Existing specs: a card updates live when its data or the census changes elsewhere

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Each patient renders as a card on the home screen showing the patient's first and last name and room (Nursing Home: unit/room).（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Hospital list open in the browser

When The room is changed and a patient is added from the backend

Then The card's room changes from 4B-01 to 7C-14 and the new card appears, with no reload

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions (Hospital only; Nursing Home live update is TC-25)

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S12 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。

UAT item: TC-01 Patient Chart Card · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-01/S12

Existing specs: a card updates live when its data or the census changes elsewhere

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-01.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • reactivity.spec.ts [chromium] — a change made elsewhere appears without a reload — expected
  • reactivity.spec.ts [chromium] — a patient added elsewhere appears on an open list — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright spec): it changes and adds patients from the backend with the local admin key; dev has no admin key, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
